meta.title: 终于有人把色彩讲清楚了！

scenes.context: 人类对色彩的描述长期停留在主观定性的层面，系统定量化描述到1920-30年代才真正开始。
sentences: Color description was subjective for ages.
定量描述始于20世纪30年代。
paraphrase: Color description was subjective for ages.
scenes.speak: Color description was subjective for ages. Quantification began around the 1930s.

scenes.context: 描述颜色大致是三个维度：色调——是红黄还是绿；亮度——暗到黑亮到白；饱和度——颜色有多纯。
sentences: Hue decides what color it is.
亮度和饱和度描述颜色。
Lightness and saturation complete the picture.
paraphrase: Hue decides what color it is.
Lightness and saturation complete the picture.
scenes.speak: Hue decides what color it is. Lightness and saturation complete the picture.

scenes.context: 绘画涂料的混合是减色法，颜色多涂在一起就偏黑；光的混合是加色法，所有光混在一起就是白。
scenes.speak: Paint mixing is subtractive. Mixing light is additive.

scenes.context: 颜色不是物体的固有物理属性，而是人眼看到物体的光谱处理后的一种感觉。
sentences: 颜色不是物体固有属性。
Color isn't a fixed physical property.
它是人眼处理光谱的结果。
It's the eye processing the spectrum.
paraphrase: Color isn't a fixed physical property.
It's the eye processing the spectrum.
scenes.speak: Color isn't a fixed physical property. It's the eye processing the spectrum.

scenes.context: 所谓光谱就是光谱功率分布，简称SPD，描述每个波长上的能量多少。
sentences: SPD stands for spectral power distribution.
It describes energy at each wavelength.
paraphrase: SPD stands for spectral power distribution.
It describes energy at each wavelength.
scenes.speak: SPD stands for spectral power distribution. It describes energy at each wavelength.

scenes.context: 人眼只有三种感光锥细胞，颜色是三种信号按比例混合出的感觉，这就是三刺激理论。
sentences: The human eye has three types of cones.
paraphrase: The human eye has three types of cones.
scenes.speak: The human eye has three types of cones. Tristimulus theory explains color matching.

scenes.context: 画家凭经验调色，科学家用数字精确描述，两者最终汇合在同一套色彩体系上。
scenes.speak: Painters mixed color by experience. Scientists described it in numbers.

scenes.context: 从主观描述到定量体系，人类一步步把「颜色」这个感觉变成了可测量、可复制的科学。
sentences: Color went from feeling to science.
paraphrase: Color went from feeling to science.
scenes.speak: Color went from feeling to science. Measurement makes color reproducible.

practice: 色彩描述曾长期停留在主观层面。
Color description was subjective for ages.
Hue decides what color it is.
人眼靠三种锥细胞看颜色。
The eye uses three cones to see color.
pitfalls: 以为颜色是物体固有属性
知道颜色是人眼的感知
光谱决定反射但感知在人眼
色调亮度饱和度是基础框架
两种体系混合规则不同
三锥细胞原理是色彩科学地基
